scope: Local builder correctness, resume, reproducibility and construction microbenchmark; not sampling-algorithm benchmark results

coverage: Full Polygon and MultiPolygon projected bounds; multipart stays one record
Country filtering by full projected geometry centroid; invalid geometry exclusions
Duplicates, repeated annotation ids and zero confidence retained
Source identity and physical CSV line retained in row-aligned metadata
One national group and one shared integer translation of both relations
Completed-checkpoint resume and existing-output checksum verification
Corrupted checkpoint rejection and changed source SHA-256 rejection
Existing unrelated output cannot be overwritten
Serial and two-worker independent rebuilds have byte-identical full SHA256SUMS including deterministic gzip exclusions
Explicit spawn worker processes avoid fork-inherited Arrow/geometry thread state

construction_microbenchmark.hardware_context: Local macOS ARM64; performance is not a prediction for the server or complex real polygons
construction_microbenchmark.input_geometry: Five-vertex rectangles, repeated/varied positions; one third outside fixed fixture country; Microsoft GeoJSONL ZIP plus Google-style WKT CSV GZIP
construction_microbenchmark.timing_scope: Complete source hash verification, streamed decode, projection/filter/quantization, checkpoint writes, metadata and memmap assembly, final hashes
construction_microbenchmark.subsequent_change: ProcessPoolExecutor now explicitly uses spawn; the microbenchmark used workers=1 and did not execute the changed branch.

limitations: Small fixtures do not substitute for full real-source validation.
Independent whole-dataset validation and source provenance review are required before dataset publication.
